sv.title: Putin lovar ”smärtsamt” svar på broattack
sv.summary: Rysslands president Vladimir Putin lovar att svaret på de senaste dagarnas ukrainska attacker mot Krimbron kommer att bli ”mycket smärtsamt”, efter att bron natten till torsdagen åter attackerats.

en.title: Putin vows "painful" response to bridge attack
en.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin vows that the response to Ukraine's attacks on the Crimean Bridge in recent days will be "very painful", after the bridge was attacked again during the night to Thursday.
